legos.why: Every practice phrase under a LEGO contains the whole LEGO (P17). The LEGO "new words | كَلِماتٍ جَديدَةً" is the seed's own words and 5 of 7 rows drill it; two rows use the singular كَلِمَةً جَديدَةً ("a new word"), a different form the seed does not say. Those two are reworded to the plural; nothing else moves.

U03: I want to learn new words in Arabic
أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ كَلِماتٍ جَديدَةً بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ

roman.أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ كَلِماتٍ جَديدَة: ureedu an ata'allama kalimaatin jadeedatan bil'arabiyyati
